scripts.test:html-theme: npm run build && cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 node cpp/tests/orchestrator/test-media.mjs --officecli-html-theme-only
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.dotnet:restore: cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 dotnet restore src/officecli/officecli.csproj
scripts.dotnet:build: cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 dotnet build src/officecli/officecli.csproj -c Release
scripts.dotnet:slnx: cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 dotnet build officecli.slnx -c Release
scripts.dotnet:publish: cmake -E rm -rf build/dotnet/publish-stage && cmake -E make_directory build/dotnet/publish-stage && cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 dotnet publish src/officecli/officecli.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 -o build/dotnet/publish-stage && cmake -E make_directory ../../dist/win-x64/bin && cmake -E copy_directory build/dotnet/publish-stage ../../dist/win-x64/bin
scripts.build:cpp: cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm --prefix cpp run build
scripts.test:cpp-office: cmake -E env OFFICECLI_NO_NETWORK=1 OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm --prefix cpp run test:office
